title: Enlight wins tender to develop solar-powered data center in southern Israel
summary: Enlight Renewables has won an Israel Land Authority tender to develop an integrated solar-powered data center and renewable energy complex in Ashalim, southern Israel. The company plans to invest up to $1.1 billion in the project, which will include a solar and energy storage facility integrated within the data center complex. This development aims to leverage existing high-voltage transmission and communication networks in the region, which is already home to the Ashalim Solar Complex.

title: Golden Eagle Strategies Plans New ETF Targeting High-Growth Stocks During Tech Rebound
summary: Golden Eagle Strategies has filed with the SEC to launch a new actively managed ETF, the Golden Eagle Dynamic Hypergrowth ETF, focusing on companies with at least 40% year-over-year growth. The ETF, with an expense ratio of 0.85%, aims to capitalize on the recent rebound in the tech sector, which follows a period of market languish. Expected to debut in mid-August 2025, the fund targets investors seeking exposure to innovation-driven, high-growth businesses.

title: NVII Stock Fund Price and Chart — CBOE:NVII
summary: The REX NVDA Growth & Income ETF (NVII) offers leveraged exposure to Nvidia (NVDA) through a strategy involving options, swaps, and NVDA shares, rebalancing daily, and employing a covered call approach. As of the article, NVII has Assets Under Management (AUM) of $78.78 million, a dividend yield of 38.95%, and an expense ratio of 0.99%. The fund, which launched on May 28, 2025, aims for active management and is noted for its high volatility and risk due to leverage.

title: Telcos Across Five Continents Are Building NVIDIA-Powered Sovereign AI Infrastructure | NVIDIA Technical Blog
summary: Telecom companies worldwide are establishing NVIDIA-powered sovereign AI infrastructure to support national AI development and offer GPU-as-a-service. This trend leverages telcos' existing infrastructure, data centers, and expertise, positioning them as trusted providers of AI cloud services to governments, enterprises, and startups. Examples include TELUS in Canada, Cassava Technologies in Africa, and Kazakhtelecom in Central Asia, all building AI factories to drive economic growth and innovation.

title: Synopsys pulls full-year guidance, citing new China export restrictions
summary: Synopsys has withdrawn its full fiscal year guidance after receiving a letter from the U.S. Commerce Department imposing new restrictions on sales of its chip design software to China. This decision comes despite CEO Sassine Ghazi previously downplaying reports of such restrictions, and follows a period of slowing growth for the company in China, which accounts for about 10% of its quarterly revenue. Rival Cadence also reported receiving a similar letter regarding export licenses for its software due to "military end use" concerns.

title: GlobalFoundries Inc.'s (NASDAQ:GFS) Price Is Out Of Tune With Revenues
summary: GlobalFoundries Inc.'s (NASDAQ:GFS) current price-to-sales (P/S) ratio of 3x is considered moderate within the Semiconductor industry, despite the company's recent revenue decline of 4.4% and an overall 4.5% drop over the last three years. Analysts forecast a modest 7.8% annual revenue growth for GlobalFoundries over the next three years, significantly lower than the industry's projected 24% growth. This disparity raises questions about why the market is not negatively impacting GFS's P/S ratio more, potentially indicating an overvaluation given its limited growth expectations.

title: REX Financial launches covered call Nvidia ETF hours before earnings release
summary: REX Financial has launched the REX NVDA Growth & Income ETF, a single-stock exchange-traded fund tied to Nvidia, just hours before Nvidia's earnings release. This covered call ETF uses option strategies to generate income and offers investors exposure to a portion of Nvidia's stock price upside, aiming to provide a balance of growth and income. The move targets self-directed individual investors seeking alternative income-generating products.

title: The AI industrial trade has found its stride again. Why our newest stock is running ahead of the pack
summary: GE Vernova stock has surged to all-time highs, outperforming peers like Eaton and Vertiv in the AI industrial trade. This comes after fears of a slowdown in AI spending and the emergence of Chinese startup DeepSeek caused market volatility. Analysts suggest GE Vernova's earlier stage in its revenue upcycle and larger backlog contribute to its stronger performance, alongside strategic deals and support for the nuclear power industry.

title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang hammers chip controls that 'effectively closed' China market
summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang voiced strong displeasure over U.S. export controls, stating they have effectively closed the $50 billion China market to the company. These restrictions led to a $2.5 billion revenue shortfall in the last quarter and a $4.5 billion write-off in unsellable inventory, with a projected $8 billion impact on current quarter orders. Huang emphasized that China will develop its own AI chips and technology, dismissing the assumption that it cannot produce them.

title: Semiconductor Market Braces for Nvidia Earnings Amid Caution
summary: The semiconductor market is showing caution ahead of Nvidia's earnings report on May 28, with significant trading in protective put options on semiconductor ETFs, indicating investor nervousness about potential volatility. Despite this, options activity on Nvidia itself is mixed, with some traders selling options, suggesting a bet against extreme post-earnings price swings. Nvidia's results are expected to significantly influence the semiconductor sector, as it is the last of the "Magnificent Seven" to report this earnings period.

title: Semiconductor ETF options show caution ahead of Nvidia results
summary: Options traders are showing increased caution ahead of Nvidia's earnings report, with defensive put options on the VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH) seeing heavy trading. While there's hedging in the SMH ETF, Nvidia's individual options trading is more mixed, with some investors selling options to capitalize on heightened volatility expectations. This suggests a nuanced approach by traders, balancing sector-wide concern with specific bets on Nvidia's post-earnings reaction.

title: REX Financial launches covered call Nvidia ETF hours before earnings release
summary: REX Financial has launched the REX NVDA Growth & Income ETF, a single-stock exchange-traded fund tied to Nvidia, just hours before Nvidia's earnings release. This covered call ETF uses option strategies to generate income and offers investors exposure to Nvidia's stock upside. The fund aims to provide investors with a comfortable risk profile and weekly income from Nvidia options, appealing to those looking for alternative income-generating products.

title: NVII ETF Analysis: Dividends, Returns CBOE:NVII
summary: This article provides an in-depth analysis of the REX NVDA Growth & Income ETF (NVII), focusing on its dividends, returns, and structure. title: Nvidia delivers another earnings and revenue beat on rampant data center growth
summary: Nvidia's shares rose almost 5% after reporting better-than-expected earnings and revenue for the first quarter, driven by a 73% year-over-year growth in its data center business. Despite missing guidance due to U.S. export restrictions on advanced chips to China, the company's strong performance in AI infrastructure and other sectors, including gaming and automotive, reassured investors. CEO Jensen Huang acknowledged the closure of the Chinese AI chip market for U.S. industry but emphasized the overwhelming global demand for Nvidia's AI solutions.

title: The only analyst on Wall Street who has a 'sell' on Nvidia says the AI chipmaker's great run is over
summary: An analyst from Seaport Research Partners, Jay Goldberg, is the sole analyst on Wall Street with a "sell" rating on Nvidia, believing the AI chipmaker's growth is plateauing. Goldberg cites supply chain limitations from TSMC and volatile trade policies as significant headwinds, particularly after a warning about a potential $5.5 billion writedown due to export license requirements for China. While other analysts remain positive, Goldberg has set a $100 price target, suggesting Broadcom as a better semiconductor investment due to its role in helping hyperscalers develop alternatives to Nvidia's chips.

title: NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for First Quarter Fiscal 2026
summary: NVIDIA reported strong first-quarter fiscal 2026 results with revenue of $44.1 billion, up 69% year-over-year, despite incurring a $4.5 billion charge due to new H20 export licensing requirements for China. The company's Data Center revenue surged to $39.1 billion, driven by robust demand for its AI infrastructure, including the Blackwell NVL72 AI supercomputer. NVIDIA also provided an optimistic outlook for Q2 fiscal 2026, anticipating $45.0 billion in revenue, even with an estimated $8.0 billion loss in H20 revenue.

title: Semiconductor ETF options show caution ahead of Nvidia results
summary: Traders in the options market are showing caution ahead of Nvidia's earnings report, with significant defensive options contracts being traded on the VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH). This reflects concerns about potential industry-wide volatility, even as options activity on Nvidia itself is more mixed, with some investors selling calls to monetize elevated premiums. The heightened activity underscores investor interest and some apprehension following an earlier strong market run.

title: Piper Sandler Warns Of The “Last Wave Of Negative News” Ahead Of NVIDIA’s Pivotal Q1’25 Earnings
summary: Piper Sandler has reiterated an 'Overweight' rating and $150 price target for NVIDIA, advising investors to remain long on the stock despite anticipated negative news ahead of Q1 2025 earnings. Analyst Harsh Kumar expects a revenue miss due to macro uncertainty and the H20 ban for China, leading to potential inventory charges and depressed margins. However, Piper Sandler foresees a strong latter half of the year for NVIDIA with improving macro forces and increased HPC capex.

title: These 2 ‘overvalued’ US tech stocks could rip higher in the second half of 2025
summary: Bank of America analysts believe Palantir Technologies (PLTR) and Cadence Design Systems (CDNS), despite being "overvalued," are poised for significant growth in the second half of 2025. PLTR's price target was raised to $150 due to its differentiated AI offerings, while CDNS is favored for its leading position in EDA and financial strength. Both companies reported strong Q1 results and raised their full-year outlooks, though neither currently pays a dividend.

title: Global Tech Alliance Launches Stargate UAE
source: ソフトバンクグループ株式会社
summary: A global tech alliance comprising G42, OpenAI, Oracle, NVIDIA, SoftBank Group, and Cisco has announced a partnership to build "Stargate UAE," a next-generation AI infrastructure cluster in Abu Dhabi. This 1-gigawatt compute cluster will be part of the newly established 5-gigawatt UAE–U.S. AI Campus and is designed to accelerate scientific discovery and innovation across various industries. The initiative forms part of the "U.S.-UAE AI Acceleration Partnership" aimed at developing safe, secure, and responsible AI globally.

title: New Intel Xeon 6 CPUs to Maximize GPU-Accelerated AI Performance
summary: Intel has announced three new Xeon 6 series CPUs with Performance-cores designed to enhance GPU-accelerated AI systems. These processors feature Priority Core Turbo technology and Intel Speed Select Technology – Turbo Frequency to optimize performance for demanding AI workloads. One of these new Xeon 6 processors, the Intel Xeon 6776P, is already integrated into NVIDIA's latest DGX B300 AI systems.

title: Spotlight: Infleqtion Optimizes Portfolios Using Q-CHOP and NVIDIA CUDA-Q Dynamics | NVIDIA Technical Blog
summary: Infleqtion, an NVIDIA partner, has developed a hybrid quantum-classical algorithm called Q-CHOP for portfolio optimization, leveraging the NVIDIA CUDA-Q platform. This algorithm, created with JPMorganChase, aims to maximize returns and minimize risks by finding optimal stock combinations, significantly improving portfolio quality with high sampling efficiency. Simulations using CUDA-Q demonstrated that Q-CHOP could achieve a higher Sharpe ratio compared to traditional methods, suggesting its potential for broader financial applications and faster performance on future quantum hardware.

title: BlackRock doubles down on AI stocks with $160 billion model portfolios
summary: BlackRock is increasing its investment in AI stocks while reducing its overall US stock exposure in its $160 billion model portfolios, citing concerns over tariffs. The firm injected $436 million into its iShares AI Innovation and Tech Active ETF (BAI), significantly expanding its size and focusing on AI leaders like Nvidia, Broadcom, and Meta. Concurrently, BlackRock is shifting funds towards global value stocks and short-term bonds, reflecting a strategic adaptation to global trade uncertainties without a diminished view of the US economy.

title: Asset Management Giant GraniteShares Launches Two ETFs Involving Bitcoin and Nvidia
summary: GraniteShares, a prominent asset management firm, has introduced two new exchange-traded funds (ETFs): the GraniteShares YieldBOOST NVDA ETF (NVYY) and the GraniteShares YieldBOOST Bitcoin ETF (XBTY). The Bitcoin ETF is designed to generate income using an options strategy tied to a 2x long Bitcoin daily ETF. This development follows the company's previous filings for leveraged ETF applications related to crypto firms such as MicroStrategy.

title: Serve is betting that food delivery and access to public markets are the keys to scaling robotics
summary: Serve Robotics, backed by Nvidia and Uber, recently raised $80 million to scale its sidewalk delivery robot fleet from 100 to 2,000 across U.S. cities, aiming for operational profitability by the end of the year. CEO Ali Kashani discusses how Serve is navigating public markets and using food delivery as a testing ground for real-world robotics. The company spun out from Postmates in 2021 and went public via reverse merger in 2024.

title: NVIDIA Selects Navitas to Collaborate on Next Generation 800 V HVDC Architecture
summary: Navitas Semiconductor is collaborating with NVIDIA on its next-generation 800 V HVDC architecture to support 'Kyber' rack-scale systems for GPUs like Rubin Ultra, utilizing Navitas' GaNFast and GeneSiC power technologies. This initiative aims to establish high-efficiency, scalable power delivery for AI workloads, reducing infrastructure complexity and improving reliability. The 800V HVDC architecture is projected to enhance end-to-end power efficiency by up to 5% and significantly lower maintenance and cooling costs in AI data centers.

title: How Will Analog Devices Stock React To Q2 Earnings?
summary: Analog Devices (ADI) is projected to report strong Q2 FY'25 earnings with anticipated revenue of $2.51 billion and EPS of $1.70, driven by improving demand in industrial, automotive, and data center sectors. Historically, ADI has shown a slightly higher probability of positive one-day post-earnings returns, particularly over the last three years. The article also discusses strategies for understanding post-earnings stock reactions, including correlations between short-term and medium-term returns and peer performance.

title: Press Kit: Intel at Computex 2025
summary: Intel celebrated 40 years of collaboration with the Taiwan ecosystem at Computex 2025 by announcing new Intel® Arc™ Pro B-Series GPUs, new deployment capabilities for Intel® Gaudi® 3 AI accelerators, and the availability of Intel® AI Assistant Builder on GitHub. The company emphasized its dedication to advancing computing architectures for AI, data centers, client workloads, prosumers, workstations, and edge computing. Intel also showcased Project Battlematrix, a configurable workstation platform designed to reduce AI developer friction points, and gave a sneak peek at its upcoming Panther Lake processors.

title: Astera Labs Expands NVIDIA Partnership to Revolutionize AI Data Center Connectivity With NVLink Fusion
summary: Astera Labs (NASDAQ: ALAB) is expanding its collaboration with NVIDIA to provide scale-up connectivity solutions for the new NVIDIA NVLink Fusion ecosystem, integrating NVLink into its Intelligent Connectivity Platform. This partnership aims to address the high bandwidth and low latency demands of next-generation AI workloads by enabling synchronization of hundreds of accelerators at rack-scale. Astera Labs has a history of industry firsts with NVIDIA, including demonstrating the first end-to-end PCIe 6 interoperability at GTC 2025.

title: Michael Burry Sells Entire Portfolio Except One Stock in Q1; Places $186M Puts on Nvidia, China Stocks
summary: Legendary investor Michael Burry has drastically reshuffled his portfolio in Q1, selling almost all his holdings except for Estée Lauder, where he doubled his stake. He also placed significant bearish put options worth $186 million on several Chinese tech stocks and, notably, on AI giant Nvidia, citing high valuations in the semiconductor sector. This move reflects Burry's contrarian investment strategy, as major Chinese tech stocks had seen a rally that later faced pressure from US tariff announcements.

title: Nvidia announces new tech to keep it at the center of AI development
summary: Nvidia announced its new "NVLink Fusion" program, allowing customers to integrate non-Nvidia CPUs and GPUs with Nvidia products, aiming to broaden its market presence in AI infrastructure. The company also unveiled the GB300 for AI workloads and the NVIDIA DGX Cloud Lepton platform. These initiatives are designed to solidify Nvidia's position in the AI development ecosystem, even as it collaborates with competitors.

title: 3 AI Stocks That Could Supercharge Your Portfolio
summary: This article identifies three AI-related stocks—Applied Digital (APLD), Oklo (OKLO), and Poet Technologies (POET)—that are poised to capitalize on the artificial intelligence boom. Applied Digital focuses on AI infrastructure, Oklo on nuclear energy for data centers, and Poet Technologies on optical connectivity solutions, each presenting unique investment opportunities in the rapidly expanding AI sector. The piece highlights their distinct technologies, market positions, and future potential.

title: Intel Gaudi 3 Expands Availability to Drive AI Innovation at Scale
summary: Dell's AI platform, featuring Intel Gaudi 3 AI accelerators, is now available to help enterprises with AI adoption. This end-to-end solution combines Intel Gaudi 3 hardware with an open-source software stack and Dell's infrastructure, offering high performance, flexibility, and cost-efficiency for various AI workloads. The platform boasts competitive generative AI price-performance, a scalable architecture, and an optimized environment for developers and IT teams.

title: The secretive US factory that lays bare the contradiction in Trump's America First plan
summary: A Taiwanese company, TSMC, is building an advanced semiconductor factory in Arizona, which will produce the world's most advanced chips in the US for the first time. This move, aiming to avoid tariffs, is seen by Trump as a success of his "America First" policy, yet the factory itself represents the globalized nature of modern technology, relying on components and expertise from across the world. The article highlights the geopolitical significance of this factory amidst US-China tensions and Taiwan's "Silicon Shield" strategy, while also pointing out the inherent contradiction in Trump's protectionist approach to an inherently global industry.

title: NVIDIA Powers World’s Largest Quantum Research Supercomputer
summary: NVIDIA announced the opening of G-QuAT, which hosts ABCI-Q, the world's largest quantum research supercomputer, developed in collaboration with Japan’s National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science and Technology (AIST). This system integrates 2,020 NVIDIA H100 GPUs and NVIDIA CUDA-Q, enabling unprecedented scale in quantum-GPU computing. ABCI-Q aims to accelerate quantum computing research by combining AI supercomputing with various quantum processors, tackling complex challenges in healthcare, energy, and finance.

title: NVIDIA Powers Humanoid Robot Industry With Cloud-to-Robot Computing Platforms for Physical AI
summary: NVIDIA has announced significant advancements in cloud-to-robot computing platforms for physical AI, introducing NVIDIA Isaac GR00T N1.5, an updated foundation model for humanoid reasoning, and Isaac GR00T-Dreams, a blueprint for generating synthetic motion data. These innovations aim to accelerate humanoid robot development by enabling faster training and adaptation to new environments, with major robot manufacturers already adopting NVIDIA's Isaac platform technologies. The company emphasizes its role in providing comprehensive building blocks for the robotics development journey, from AI brains to simulation environments.

title: NVIDIA Launches AI-First DGX Personal Computing Systems With Global Computer Makers
summary: NVIDIA has announced new DGX Spark and DGX Station personal AI supercomputers, built by leading manufacturers like Acer, ASUS, Dell Technologies, GIGABYTE, HP, Lenovo, and MSI. These systems are designed to offer unprecedented AI performance and efficiency for developers, researchers, and data scientists, addressing the growing demand for robust AI computing solutions that can handle agentic AI systems. Powered by NVIDIA Grace Blackwell platforms, they enable prototyping, fine-tuning, and inference of models from desktop to data center, with DGX Spark available in July and DGX Station later this year.

title: NVIDIA Unveils NVLink Fusion for Industry to Build Semi-Custom AI Infrastructure With NVIDIA Partner Ecosystem
summary: NVIDIA has introduced NVLink Fusion, a new silicon technology designed to empower industries to develop semi-custom AI infrastructure by leveraging NVIDIA’s NVLink ecosystem. Key partners like MediaTek, Marvell, Alchip Technologies, Astera Labs, Synopsys, and Cadence are adopting NVLink Fusion to create custom AI silicon for demanding model training and agentic AI inference workloads. Additionally, Fujitsu and Qualcomm Technologies plan to integrate their custom CPUs with NVIDIA GPUs using NVLink Fusion, scale-up, and Spectrum-X scale-out technologies to build high-performance AI factories.

title: Spotlight: Perfect Corp. Delivers Personalized Digital Beauty Experiences Using NVIDIA TensorRT and NVENC
summary: Perfect Corp. is leveraging NVIDIA TensorRT and NVENC to provide hyperpersonalized digital beauty experiences through augmented reality (AR) and AI. These technologies enable real-time skin analysis, AI-generated hairstyles, and accelerated video processing for features like AI Video Face Swap. This enhances realism, accuracy, and performance in their applications, making digital shopping more engaging and efficient.

title: NVIDIA RTX PRO Servers Speed Trillion-Dollar Enterprise IT Industry Transition to AI Factories
summary: NVIDIA announced its RTX PRO Servers and a new Enterprise AI Factory validated design to accelerate the trillion-dollar IT industry's transition to AI factories. These servers, built with NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs, offer universal acceleration for AI, design, engineering, and business applications. Companies like Cadence, Foxconn, and Lilly are already planning to adopt this infrastructure, with global system makers and consulting firms supporting the deployment.

title: Foxconn Builds AI Factory in Partnership With Taiwan and NVIDIA
summary: NVIDIA and Foxconn are partnering with the Taiwan government to build an AI factory supercomputer, featuring 10,000 NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, to boost AI computing for researchers, startups, and industries in Taiwan. This initiative, led by Foxconn's subsidiary Big Innovation Company, will also support TSMC's R&D and the Taiwan National Science and Technology Council's efforts to accelerate AI development across various sectors. The AI factory aims to enhance smart cities, electric vehicles, and manufacturing through advanced AI infrastructure and cloud services.

title: Just Four Days Till Microchip Technology Incorporated (NASDAQ:MCHP) Will Be Trading Ex-Dividend
summary: Microchip Technology Incorporated (NASDAQ:MCHP) is set to trade ex-dividend in four days, with a dividend payment of US$0.455 per share scheduled for June 5th. The company paid a total of US$1.82 last year, resulting in a 3.0% trailing yield on its current stock price of US$61.21. Despite being unprofitable last year, Microchip Technology has shown improving income over the past five years and has consistently increased its dividend by approximately 9.8% annually over the last decade.

title: TSS Stock Jumps On AI-fueled Q1 Results, Strong Guidance: Retail Exuberance Abounds
summary: TSS, Inc. (TSSI) shares surged after reporting significant increases in Q1 2025 profits and revenue, driven by strong growth in procurement and systems integration, including AI rack integration services. The company's EPS reached $0.12, and revenue climbed 523% year-over-year to $99 million, leading to "extremely bullish" sentiment on Stocktwits and a 51.07% jump in after-hours trading. TSS also provided positive guidance for the remainder of the year and into 2026, expecting full-year 2025 adjusted EBITDA to be at least 50% higher than 2024.

title: Breakthrough: Ekso Bionics Partners With NVIDIA to Create Revolutionary AI-Powered Rehabilitation Technology
summary: Ekso Bionics has been accepted into the NVIDIA Connect program, initiating a strategic move to develop the world's first foundation model for human motion in physical rehabilitation. Leveraging NVIDIA's resources, including specialized training and GPU platforms, Ekso Bionics aims to integrate new AI capabilities across its device portfolio. CEO Scott Davis highlights this collaboration as the beginning of their AI journey to enhance exoskeleton technology and improve patient outcomes through personalized rehabilitation.

title: Qualcomm confirms it is re-entering the data center CPU market, starting with Saudi Arabia's AI cloud project
summary: Qualcomm has announced its re-entry into the data center CPU market, partnering with Saudi Arabia's HUMAIN AI for a state-backed AI cloud infrastructure project. This move follows Qualcomm's previous attempt in 2017 and aims to establish cutting-edge AI data centers in Saudi Arabia using Qualcomm's edge and data center solutions. The agreement also includes the establishment of a Qualcomm Design Center in Saudi Arabia, building on their acquisition of Nuvia and recent high-profile hires.

title: How AGIX and KWEB Provide Access To The Distinct U.S. & China AI Ecosystems
summary: The article discusses how combining AGIX and KWEB ETFs offers a blended approach to investing in the global AI opportunity by accessing both the U.S. and China AI ecosystems. It highlights the distinct characteristics and developments within each region's AI landscape, from the U.S.'s rapid innovation spurred by ChatGPT to China's cost-effective, open-source models exemplified by DeepSeek. The piece concludes that a combined portfolio effectively harnesses the long-term growth potential of the AI sector by leveraging the complementary strengths of both countries.

title: Bit Digital, Inc. Announces First Quarter of Fiscal Year 2025 Financial Results
summary: Bit Digital, Inc. announced its financial results for the First Quarter of 2025, reporting a total revenue of $25.1 million, a 17% decrease year-over-year, primarily due to a decline in digital asset mining revenue following the April 2024 halving. Cloud services revenue, however, saw an 84% increase, significantly offsetting the decrease. The company also highlighted strategic advancements in its infrastructure platform and diversification of revenue streams, including new cloud services agreements and the rebranding of its HPC business as WhiteFiber.

title: Supermicro's Revolutionary Data Center Building Block Solutions® (DCBBS) Simplify and Shorten Global-Scale Buildouts of AI/IT Liquid-Cooled Data Centers
summary: Supermicro introduces its Data Center Building Block Solutions (DCBBS) to simplify and accelerate the deployment of liquid-cooled AI/IT data centers globally. This solution is designed to overcome the complexities of outfitting AI factories by providing pre-validated scalable units, comprehensive services, and customized options. DCBBS aims to reduce costs, improve quality, and offer significant power and footprint savings, leading to a 20% lower Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).

title: South Korea’s SK Telecom reports growth in data center and AI-related business for Q1 2025
summary: SK Telecom reported significant year-on-year growth in its data center and AI-related businesses for Q1 2025, despite a slight decrease in overall revenue and net income, alongside a recent data breach. The company aims to open hyperscale data centers by 2027 and is focusing on increasing data center utilization and expanding its GPU-as-a-Service offering. Investments in AI data centers and partnerships signal future growth, with new hyperscale AI data centers planned for South Korea.

title: Quantum Computing Inc. opens thin-film lithium niobate fab for photonic chips
summary: Quantum Computing Inc. (QCi) has launched a new thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) optical chip foundry in Tempe, Arizona, to meet the growing demand for TFLN photonic chips and accelerate its quantum computer commercialization. The facility, completed in March 2025, is now operational, fulfilling pre-orders and targeting the datacom, telecom, advanced sensing, and quantum computing markets. QCi aims to control its supply chain and provide custom TFLN chips, envisioning significant revenue growth from this venture as the TFLN market is projected to reach nearly $2 billion by 2029.

title: AI-Based US Stock Trading Below $35 to Watch for Explosive Returns
summary: The article highlights DigitalOcean Holdings Inc. (NYSE: DOCN) as an attractive AI-based US stock, especially for small and medium businesses due to its affordable cloud computing and AI services. Despite a significant drop from its all-time high, the company is expanding its market share at its current trading price of $31, suggesting potential for substantial growth and profits for investors. Investing in DOCN now, while it's trading below $35, could lead to explosive returns as the company continues to penetrate the SMB market.

title: Nasdaq 100 ETF hits all-time high: Is Invesco QQQ the ultimate AI bet?
summary: The Invesco QQQ ETF, which tracks the tech-heavy Nasdaq 100 index, has reached an all-time high, closing at $546.22 on June 26th. With technology stocks making up 57.23% of its portfolio and major holdings like Nvidia, Microsoft, and Apple, the QQQ is presented as a strong, risk-adjusted investment for those looking to capitalize on the AI revolution. Its performance highlights significant growth over the last one, three, and five years.

title: J&J teams with Nvidia, Amazon on fund for AI surgery solutions
summary: Johnson & Johnson has partnered with Nvidia and Amazon Web Services (AWS) to launch the Polyphonic AI Fund for Surgery. This initiative aims to support the development and implementation of artificial intelligence solutions in surgical procedures. J&J is offering grants, mentorship, and access to computing resources to developers focusing on AI model development, data management, and governance in surgery.

title: Cyngn Shares Skyrocket After NVIDIA Highlights Its Autonomous Tech
summary: Cyngn's stock soared after NVIDIA featured its autonomous technology at the Computex 2024 keynote. NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang highlighted Cyngn's AI-driven industrial vehicles, leading to a significant increase in investor interest and stock value for the autonomous vehicle solutions company. The recognition by NVIDIA underscores Cyngn's advancements in practical AI applications within the logistics and material handling sectors.

title: CoreWeave reportedly seeking to acquire data center operator Core Scientific
summary: CoreWeave Inc. is reportedly moving to acquire Core Scientific Inc., a key infrastructure provider for its AI cloud platform, according to sources cited by The Wall Street Journal. This potential acquisition comes as Core Scientific has become one of CoreWeave’s most important partners, providing substantial data center capacity crucial for CoreWeave's AI operations. The deal would be CoreWeave's second major acquisition this year, following its purchase of AI tooling provider Weights & Biases Inc.

title: HIVE hits $115.3M revenue in FY2025 as AI cloud earnings triple
summary: HIVE Digital Technologies reported $115.3 million in revenue for fiscal year 2025, driven by strong Bitcoin mining and significant growth in its AI cloud operations. Despite a slight decrease in digital currency mining revenue due to the Bitcoin halving and increased hash rate difficulty, the company's AI cloud segment tripled its earnings. HIVE expanded its mining hashrate by 40% and grew its GPU fleet to 5,000 to meet rising AI demand, while also increasing infrastructure in Paraguay.

title: A tiny robotics company is more than tripling after drawing attention to its relationship with Nvidia
summary: Shares of Cyngn Inc., a tiny industrial robotics company, surged over 300% after announcing its collaboration with Nvidia at the Automatica 2025 robotics and automation showcase. Nvidia's blog post highlighted Cyngn as an innovator using Nvidia Isaac technologies, leading to a significant increase in Cyngn's market cap despite its historically low revenue. This event mirrors a similar surge seen with Navitas Semiconductor after its relationship with Nvidia was brought to light.

title: Stock Market Today: S&P 500 flattens as Nvidia breaks records
summary: U.S. stocks saw mixed results, with the S&P 500 flattening and the Nasdaq Composite rising, largely due to Nvidia's record-breaking rally to $154.31, reaching its highest ever valuation. Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell expressed caution over potential inflation from tariffs, dampening hopes for early interest rate cuts, while investors now await Friday's PCE inflation report for further market direction.
